name: crew-shots
description: Shooting: one item per shot. The cinematographer makes the start frame (critic + director storyboard gate), the actors perform when the shot is acted, the cinematographer shoots takes, the critic judges every take, the director approves the take.

steps.name: frame
steps.job: Role: cinematographer, making this shot's start frame (the storyboard frame). Load and follow skill cast-and-sets (consistency from reference sheets) and the project bible. Inputs: the item's data (the shot from shots.json) plus <dir>/bible/tokens.md, <dir>/assets.json and the approved sheets under <dir>/cast/. Make 1-2 candidate start frames with fal-ai/nano-banana-pro/edit using the cast/set key images as references (16:9, 2K, jpeg), composed for the action and the 2.39:1 centre band, nobody looking into the lens unless briefed. Write them to <dir>/plates/<id>/frame/. Log spend to <dir>/ledger.jsonl. Record the step with vex.factory.step.complete: {"files": [absolute paths], "kind": "image", "summary": "<2 lines>"}. Never edit shared project files.

steps.name: storyboard
steps.question: Director: is this start frame approved for the shot (continue), re-made (redo), or is the shot dropped (close)?

steps.name: perform
steps.job: Role: the actor(s) in this shot. Load and follow skill performance. Inputs: the item's data (the shot from shots.json: id, read, cast, lines, eyelines, duration) plus <dir>/cast/ and <dir>/assets.json. If the shot has no acting, record {"files": [], "skipped": true}. Otherwise make the drivers and re-voiced lines under <dir>/plates/<id>/perform/. Record {"files": [...], "kind": "video", "lines": [...], "summary": ...}; on failure vex.factory.step.fail with the reason.

steps.name: shoot
steps.job: Role: cinematographer for this shot. Load and follow skill seedance-plates and the field notes it cites; use the perform step's files when present (motion-control). Make 2 takes of the shot under <dir>/plates/<id>/ from its start frame and shot brief, draft first, logging spend to <dir>/ledger.jsonl. Record the step with vex.factory.step.complete: {"files": [absolute paths you wrote], "kind": "video", "summary": "<2 lines>"}. If the unit cannot be made, vex.factory.step.fail with the reason. Never edit shared project files (brief, bible, tokens, assets.json, shots.json, edit, mix).

steps.name: approve
steps.question: Director: use the critic's best take for this shot (continue), re-shoot (redo), or drop the shot (close)?
